title: Archeology and archeological works
competency: Explain how archeology and fossils help us study pre-history.

keywords.def: The science in which archeologists dig out material objects and fossils of the past.
The remains of dead plants, human beings and animals.
The distant past before writing and recording began.

en.text: Archeology is the science in which archeologists dig out material objects and fossils of the past. Fossils are remains of dead plants, people and animals. They help us learn about pre-history, the time before writing began.

screens.title: No books, no writing
screens.ask: Nobody wrote books two million years ago. How can we know how early people lived?
opts: From bones and objects dug out of the ground
screens.after: Scientists dig out old bones and tools. These remains tell the story of the past. This work is called archeology.

screens.title: 2.1.1 Archeology and archeological works
paras: Archeology is the science in which archeologists dig out material objects and fossils of the past.
It helps us in the study of pre-history.
Pre-history was the distant past before the beginning of writing and recording.

screens.title: Fossils
paras: Fossils are the remains of dead plants, human beings and animals.
The study of fossils and other remains helps us rebuild what happened before writing started.
screens.note: Figure 2.1 shows a fossil skeleton in a glass case, like the Lucy (Dinkinesh) display in Addis Ababa.

screens.title: What can archeologists find?
items: A material object made by early people. Archeologists dig it out.
The remains of a dead human ancestor.
Fossils can also be remains of plants.

screens.ask: The remains of dead plants, animals and human beings are called ___.
screens.why: Fossils are the remains of dead plants, human beings and animals.
screens.clue: Archeologists dig them out of the ground.

screens.text: Pre-history is the time after people started writing.
screens.why: Pre-history is the distant past BEFORE writing and recording began.

screens.text: A farmer near Hadar finds an old bone in the ground. Who should study it, and why?
opts: A banker, to know its price
An archeologist, because fossils tell us about pre-history
screens.ans: An archeologist, because fossils tell us about pre-history
screens.why: Archeologists study fossils and objects of the past. These remains help rebuild the time before writing.
screens.clue: Which expert digs out and studies fossils?

test.ask: The science that digs out objects and fossils of the past is ___.

test.text: Fossils are the remains of dead plants, human beings and animals.
Why do historians need fossils for pre-history?
opts: There are no written records from that time
test.ans: There are no written records from that time
test.why: Pre-history has no writing, so remains are the evidence.

test.text: Which one is NOT a fossil?
opts: A bone of an early human
The print of a leaf in old rock
A tooth of an old animal
test.why: A book is a written record. Fossils are remains of living things.
